bias.en: Turning bearish · back above $250, capped at the 10 and 30-day
bias.zh: 转弱 · 重回 $250 上方，受制于 10 日和 30 日均线

read.en: Amazon rose 1.6% on Oct 27 to $253.10, trading between $248.71 and $254.67. It is above the falling 5-day ($252.6) and 100-day ($251.8) and the rising 200-day ($243.3), and just below the falling 30-day ($253.5) and 10-day ($254.7). MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 23 and is below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 22 ($263.54), and RSI is 49.
read.zh: 亚马逊 10月27日上涨 1.6%，收于 $253.10，盘中区间 $248.71–254.67。股价位于下行的 5 日（$252.6）和 100 日均线（$251.8）以及上行的 200 日均线（$243.3）上方，略低于下行的 30 日（$253.5）和 10 日均线（$254.7）。MACD 于 10月23日下穿信号线，位于零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月22日起看空（$263.54），RSI 为 49。

read.en: The close cleared the $249.3–250.8 cap and the 100-day, now support, but the $254.7 high stopped at the 10-day. Resistance is $253.5–254.7 (30 and 10-day), then $255.6 (Oct 15–16 highs) and $262.5–263.5 (Oct 19–21 closes, SAR). Support is $250.8–251.8, then $246.5–248.7 (Oct 23 and 27 lows) and $243.3–244.7 (200-day, September lows). A close above $255.6 would target $262–265; below $248.7, $244.
